def equation(t, P, params):
    w = params[9]

         + params[4]*np.exp(-t) + params[5]*np.log(t) + params[6]*np.sqrt(t)
         + params[7]*np.sin(w*t)/t)
    return g/P + params[8]*P*np.log(P) + 0.6480*t
